description: Create a Suno task on RunAPI (extend music). Returns a task id, status, and output URLs.

audio_id.description: Source audio ID to extend. Provide one of task_id, audio_id, audio_url, or upload_url. Declared type: string.

audio_url.description: Source audio URL to extend. Provide one of task_id, audio_id, audio_url, or upload_url. Declared type: string.

callback_url.description: Webhook URL for async notifications. Declared type: string.

continue_at.description: Seconds into the source to continue from. Required in custom parameter mode. Declared type: number.

instrumental.description: When true, generate without vocals. Declared type: boolean.

lyrics.description: Exact lyrics. Only allowed when extending uploaded audio in custom parameter mode. Declared type: string.

model.description: RunAPI model slug for this model line.

negative_tags.description: Styles to avoid. Declared type: string.

parameter_mode.description: Inherit the source track's parameters (source) or supply custom ones (custom). Declared type: string. Known values: "source", "custom".

persona_type.description: Persona type. Declared type: string. Known values: "style", "voice".

prompt.description: Extension brief. Cannot be combined with lyrics. Declared type: string.

style.description: Style preset. Required in custom parameter mode. Declared type: string.

style_weight.description: Style adherence weight (0-1). Declared type: number.

task_id.description: Source task ID to extend. Provide one of task_id, audio_id, audio_url, or upload_url. Declared type: string.

title.description: Song title. Required in custom parameter mode. Declared type: string.

upload_url.description: Uploaded source audio URL to extend. Provide one of task_id, audio_id, audio_url, or upload_url. Declared type: string.

vocal_gender.description: Vocal gender. Declared type: string. Known values: "male", "female".

wait.description: Poll until the task reaches a terminal status.

name: extend_music
